# DEMO: the J3D-HDREW#1 start-up fragment (app start-up profile B)
# (read-only copy) run under `osmem hle fs threads` WITHOUT the option-B audio skips. Changes against the fragment's file:
#  - `osmem hle fs` -> `osmem hle fs threads mainthread=5D400000`
#  - dropped: nestedret 020314C4 0 / 02896A40 1 / 02889F18 0 (the audio skips), ret! C0009BB0 1 (OSGetCoreId: per thread),
#    mockthreadspecific + mockretfield C0009CC0/028FDF38 (the threads part answers them)
#  - added `real`: the static closure over direct calls and code-constant function addresses (e.g. element constructors
#    passed to __construct_new_array; for functions the fragment already lists in these ranges, their code-constant targets, e.g. the nw::snd thread entry 028F6AF0;
#    plus every JAudio (0280-0282) function referenced from .data/.rodata, and the direct closure inside JAudio (0280-0284)
#    also through functions the fragment lists (e.g. 02844200 under 02811518, reached once the AX frames wake JAudio), e.g. the thread run methods 02813C84/02810B9C/0281B024
#    that the JAudio entry 02810D20 reaches through the vtable at +0x54) (inside 0276xxxx, 0280-0282, 0288-028B, 028E-028F; not through functions the
#    fragment already lists) of the thread entries 027625E8 02898F88 0289C998 02810D20 and the audio boundaries 02761640 020314C4
#    02896A40 02889F18 02803494, minus Thread::start 02760B1C and the run loop 0274BF78 (kept
#    as the fragment has them: the TaskMgr worker is not started)

# SHARED FRAGMENT (include only; no tested function): original HD app startup per 
# hdAppMain 02005EA8 -> Framework::run 027476D8 -> TaskMgr::create/construct 027496EC/02749388
# (root request queued by 02749364, never dispatched: Thread::start 02760B1C is not real, so no worker runs), then the
# original TaskMgr::createTaskSync 02749ECC on that manager's own mRootTaskArgs (TaskMgr+0xB8) -> HdRootTask
# prepare 0203EE2C -> 0203EA88 -> 027B56D0 -> 027A78F8. OS/MEM answers: `osmem hle` (port HLE).
osmem hle fs threads ax mainthread=5D400000
mockset C000A858 r3 r4 r5
mockmove C000A848 r3 r4 r5
mockmove C0009988 r3 r4 r5
mockset C0009990 r3 r4 r5
# GX2 query/fetch/display-list models of the port HLE, as in shared/agl_world.txt (lines 150-161)
mockfetchsize C00060B8
mockfetchinit C0006400
mockdisplaylist C0006090 C0006190 C0006218 0x100
mockretfield C0006390 r3 0 0 0xFF
mockretfield C0006398 r3 0 8 0xFF
mockretfield C00062D0 r3 0 0 0xFF
mockretfield C00062D8 r3 0 8 0xFF
mockmove 028FDC00 r3 r4 r5
# GX2TempGetGPUVersion: the port HLE answers 2 (runtime/src/gx2/gx2_core.cpp:505); not in osmem gx2
ret! C0006AA8 2
# OSGetCoreId: the main thread runs on core 1 (port threads.cpp:670; OSGetCoreId returns t_self->core, :747)
# (demo) dropped: ret! C0009BB0 1
# (demo) dropped: mockthreadspecific C000A090,028FE308 C0009CC8,028FDF40 5D400000 C0009BC8,028FDE40
fill * 5D400000 0x1000 0
field * 5D400330 u32 16
stable 5D400330 4
stable 5D40057C 0x40
# (demo) dropped: mockretfield C0009CC0 r3 0x330 0 0xFFFFFFFF
# (demo) dropped: mockretfield 028FDF38 r3 0x330 0 0xFFFFFFFF
# boot order of the RPX entry 028EA120 (wdis): the static-init runner 028EA09C, then the exit-handler registration
# 028F01B4(028F0260), then hdAppMain 02005EA8 (whose own 028EA09C call is then a no-op through the flag 101FCBB8)
setup * 028EA09C
setup * 028F01B4 r3=0x028F0260
setup * 02005EA8 r3=0 r4=0
# agl graphics resource: 0203EA88's ResourceMgr load of "agl_resource_cafe_dev.sarc" (rodata 10006564) runs original
# through sead::ResourceMgr::tryLoad 0275DB94 down to coreinit FS, answered by the osmem `fs` part
# ((A) replaces the earlier (B) nestedret at 0275DB94). Every file read is hash-listed below.
osmemfile /vol/content/Cafe/Common/agl_resource_cafe_dev.sarc 305f53babcadc9731215e40e1a36da5030ccf1b8d76e3eddd0341423f7fdfcb7
# absent probes: HdRootTask::prepare mounts the hard-coded "Cafe/JP/" (rodata 10006624)
# as the "local" file device (0203EF48..0203EF74 -> 0273EFF8); the shipped US content has only Cafe/Common and Cafe/US, so
# the console and the port answer not-found for every probe on that device:
osmemfile /vol/content/Cafe/JP/primitive_renderer/primitive_renderer_cafe.gsh absent
# common archive: 0203EE2C's hdRootLoadArchiveResource 02612E64 of
# "Misc/Misc.szs" (rodata 100065F0) is an FS load the verifier skips; the HD ResMgr lookup 026123FC answers the archive object
# built by the original 0275E11C/0275D21C from the shipped bytes (content/Common/Misc/Misc.szs, Yaz0, sha256
# 2bc5b3c42e98cbfbe3e9df1f4dd4bcc3444c766e4c202f764b2fa85c339a2219, SARC 0x8E300). Later archives are rebuilt at the same
# object before their own lookup. Reserved: 0x58100000-0x58100FFF (object), 0x59000000-0x5908E2FF (Misc bytes).
blobfile * 0x59000000 content/Common/Misc/Misc.szs:<yaz0>
stable 0x59000000 0x8E300
fill * 0x58100000 0x1000 0
setup * 0275E11C r3=0x58100000
setup * 0275D21C r3=0x58100000 r4=0x59000000 r5=0x8E300 r6=0x8E300 r7=0 r8=0
nestedret 026123FC 0x58100000
# route (b): the
# function that holds the whole loop, agl::ShaderMgr::initialize 02786520 (r3 = sShaderMgr *101F8D6C, r4 = the
# agl_resource_cafe_dev archive, r5 = heap), called once at 027B5A34 in 027B59F4 (from 0203EA88 in HdRootTask::prepare).
# Its three loops (6 program binaries via 027B8904 at 02786630; the 0x84-entry program/variation registration
# 02786678..0278B8BC; the per-program variation build 027B9070 -> 027B9F78 at 0278B8EC) are all inside it.
# 02786520 has no return value (void: no r3 is set before its blr at 0278B90C) and its caller 027B59F4 never reads r3
# after 027B5A34 (027B5A5C reloads r3); nestedret answers 1, the r3 the original leaves on success (shared/agl_world
# setup 02786520 -> r3 00000001). Watch proof: see the spec comment of the including profile / results ctor-startup-b.md.
nestedret 02786520 1
# the game shader program set 0273918C runs original (fs (A) has landed); its three sharcfb files are
# hash-listed below. (The interim 14:10 skip is withdrawn: the graphics task's render-buffer layer 0272BD70 reads the
# third program through *101F8A94 +0x14 +0xB8 -> 027B90AC.)
# audio setup boundaries, option B (llocations from the audio
# task heap after the 020314C4 skip are layout-tainted). 02761640 and 027651B8 run original. Skipped:
# - 020314C4 (void; module-list vcall at 02761860, r3 unread: 02761864 add r11): game audio create, JAIZelBasic::init
#   02026044 + 0280348C (02803494 waits for the audio thread with OSSleepTicks).
# - 02896A40 (r3 = 1, its success value: li r3,1 at 02896AD8; caller 027648E4 at 02764940 never reads r3): the sound-archive
#   player command setup; its slot allocation 02887248 waits for nw::snd init on the audio thread.
# - 02889F18 (void; from 0202F1C4 at 0202F224, r3 unread: 0202F228): sound master-volume command, same allocator.
# Write sets and -watch list: local trace files (optionB.md, union list).
# (demo) dropped: nestedret 020314C4 0
# (demo) dropped: nestedret 02896A40 1
# (demo) dropped: nestedret 02889F18 0
real 027338D8
# drift guard: TaskMgr literal 0x44208C8C (trace: 027496EC returns it); its mFramework (+0x40) -> Framework (+0x18) is non-zero
setup * 027E2DC0 r3=*(*0x44208CCC+0x18)
setup * 02749ECC r3=0x44208C8C r4=0x44208D44
# guard: createTaskSync stored the created root task through the request's own mCreatedTask = &TaskMgr.mRootTask (+0xB4)
setup * 027E2DC0 r3=*0x44208D40
real 027E2DC0
real 02000FF0 02001124 020011CC 02001228 020014A0 02001534 0200167C 02001790 02001924 0200196C 02001C1C 02002168
